question: About how many hours do you sleep? Re:Zero has so many characters and so much depth, so I'm curious how you've come up with all those settings and backgrounds.
answer:
I think everyone has the misconception that I don't sleep at all, but I sleep about 6–8 hours! (laughs)

Basically, no matter what I'm doing while I'm awake, I'm always thinking about Re:Zero somewhere in the back of my mind, so I think all that time ends up working out nicely.
